facts.fact: 叙述者与 Kay 在宅子西塔楼找到 Genevieve
facts.anchor: We found Genevieve in the West Tower.

facts.fact: 她的办公室被大平桌、文件柜和书架塞得满满当当
facts.anchor: Genevieve’s office was cluttered with a big flattop desk

facts.fact: Kay 举起手机要求为这次问话录音，说这是标准程序
facts.anchor: Do you mind if I record this? It’s standard procedure.

facts.fact: 但 Kay 先前问门卫 Alberto 时并没有录音
facts.anchor: Except that she hadn’t recorded our interview with Alberto.

facts.fact: Genevieve 把 Kay 的「节哀」误当成在说 Deirdre
facts.anchor: You don’t think I’m sad that woman is dead, do you?

facts.fact: 她说那女人自己选择死在她家门口，不是她的错
facts.anchor: It’s not my fault that woman decided to die on my doorstep.

facts.fact: 她说是 Abi 今早告诉她 Deirdre 昨晚威胁过她
她解释自己只是不愿提那两个人的名字
她说自己凌晨两点出门、四点回来
facts.anchor: I left at two and came back at four

facts.fact: 她承认回来时可能没有把前门重新锁上
Kay 问前门一共有几把钥匙
facts.anchor: how many house keys are there for the front door?

facts.fact: Genevieve 说四把钥匙分别在她、Rose、Abi 和 Dan 手里
facts.anchor: I’ve got one and so does Rose.
